title: Possessed Man Refuses To Leave Walmart After Trying To Steal Item, Doesn't End Well For Him
description:
#news #police #arrest

On September 1st, 2022. An officer was dispatched to a Walmart in regards to man refusing to leave even after store employees told him to vacate the premises. The man did not seem to be in the right state of mind due to how he was behaving and the things he was saying. He also failed to provide his name and did not have any I.D on him.
